image_description: A high-angle, slightly distant shot of an ornate church altar. The central focus is a white-clothed table (the mensa) with a floral arrangement and candles. Behind it rises a large, elaborate stone or plaster reredos (altarpiece) featuring Gothic-style arches, statues, and painted panels. To the left and right are tall, dark wooden columns or pilasters with vertical paintings. The lighting is warm and ambient, typical of a cathedral interior.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is noticeable softness and lack of sharp detail in the complex carvings of the altarpiece and the figures in the side paintings. This could be due to camera focus/depth of field or AI generation smoothing out high-frequency details. It is not catastrophic but reduces realism.

The lace pattern on the front of the cloth appears slightly repetitive and lacks the random irregularities of real fabric. The folds are somewhat smooth and plastic-like rather than showing crisp fabric tension.

The vertical lines of the architecture show slight waviness or bending, particularly on the left side, which deviates from the rigid straightness expected in stone/wood architecture. This suggests minor geometric instability.
